[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided the meeting topic as "Proposal for website creation."

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jane confirmed she received the proposal document and wanted to discuss some details.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] David stated he was available to answer any questions.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] John asked Jane to start discussing her requirements for the website.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jane specified that the website should be simple, user-friendly, and visually appealing, with a blog section for news and updates.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] David confirmed they could design a website that meets these requirements and offered to show design options.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jane requested to see design options.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] John asked David to explain the technical aspects of the website, including the platform and hosting.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] David stated they planned to use WordPress as the platform and recommended a reliable web hosting service.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] John inquired about the project timeline.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] David estimated the project would take around 4-6 weeks to complete, depending on design complexity and content provided.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jane found the timeline reasonable and requested a detailed breakdown of the project costs.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] David agreed to provide a detailed quote including all costs for design, development, hosting, and maintenance.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] John asked if there was anything else to discuss before wrapping up the meeting.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jane requested references or samples of David's previous work.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] David agreed to send links to previous projects similar to what Jane was looking for.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] John thanked David and stated they would review the information provided and get back soon.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jane expressed appreciation for the productive meeting and thanked John and David for their help in capturing details.
